rows.grounds: nominal stem aśvattha; final visarga becomes o before voiced g in sandhi
fused sandhi form: guggulu + ca + eva; kept as one token
nominal stem lājira; accusative singular in enumerated list
compound noun kṛṣṇa-jīraka; accusative singular in enumerated list

items.question: What additional substances are included in the ongoing enumerated ritual list?
premises: The sacred fig is named as an item in the list.
Guggulu is also included as an item in the list.
Lājira and black cumin are added to the enumeration.
items.inference: These named substances continue the prescribed enumeration of ritual materials.
uncertainties: The precise botanical identification of lājira is not determined from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Sacred fig, guggulu as well, and also lājira and black cumin.
